verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms a search bar and a simple `{{query}}` mechanism for questioning the knowledge base. Logseq is described as offline-first with local data, which implies search works offline. However, the pack never documents full-text search behavior or filtering by tags, properties or paths. A community report also says indexing and responsiveness slow down massively on large graphs, which undercuts "instant". Missing for 10: documented full-text search, explicit tag/property/path filters, evidence that search runs offline, evidence of fast search at scale.
